FAQ.title: Frequently asked questions
FAQ.intro: A few helpful answers before choosing a product.
FAQ.a1: Roya focuses on fresh homemade finger foods, snack platters, sausages and cold cuts with no additives. Check exact ingredients and storage instructions in each product description or contact Roya.
FAQ.a2: Each product has its own minimum and increment, displayed on its product page. Use the quantity controls to select a valid amount.
FAQ.a3: The longest preparation time among the ordered items is added to delivery time for your zone. Your final estimate will appear after selecting a zone and placing an order.
FAQ.q4: Which cities do you deliver to?
FAQ.a4: Delivery zones and fees will be configured before sales open. Available zones will be shown during checkout.
FAQ.q5: How can I check for allergens?
FAQ.a5: If you have a food allergy, confirm ingredients with Roya before ordering. “No additives” does not mean allergen-free.
FAQ.q6: How should I store a product?
FAQ.a6: Storage and shelf life depend on the product, particularly for homemade sausages and cold cuts. Ask Roya for product-specific refrigeration, cooking and consumption instructions.
FAQ.a7: Cart and checkout are implemented. The demonstration does not create real orders. Real sales require a configured database, delivery zones and payment gateway.
